result.message: Finally—success, but only because you read all four events before committing. That's the bare minimum, not praise-worthy. Two failed episodes cost you the lesson it took to get here. Next time read the full event set before turn one, not after burning attempts. Verify-then-route, every time, no exceptions.
result.rationale: Episode succeeded because learner exhaustively read events before routing, contrasting with the prior two failed episodes where routing was premature. Short horizon: reinforce the correct process just demonstrated while critiquing that it took two failures to get there, keeping critique on reasoning/process not the learner.
